usage: score_byte_mixture.py [-h] {fit-counts,score} ...

Fit portable TRAIN counts, or score a frozen neural/count probability mix. The
score command accepts one already trained, trusted Singularity byte-model
checkpoint. It never trains a neural model, chooses alpha, or fits a blend
weight. Choose hyperparameters on a separate TUNE corpus before using TEST.

positional arguments:
  {fit-counts,score}
    fit-counts        Fit portable JSON counts using TRAIN only; no alpha
                      selection
    score             Score one trusted checkpoint and a FROZEN supplied
                      mixture weight

options:
  -h, --help          show this help message and exit

Run with PYTHONPATH=src, or install the package. fit-counts needs only Python;
score needs the training extra. Checkpoints contain pickle and must come from
a trusted source.

reference.

usage: check_runtime_pipeline.py [-h] --source-dir SOURCE_DIR
                                 [--results RESULTS] [--study STUDY]
                                 [--output OUTPUT]

Show that an unchanged checkpoint can have a changed runtime pipeline. A
forward hook zeros positional-embedding OUTPUTS without modifying any saved
weights. One selected-context pass is compared with existing cached healthy
and no-position outputs. This is a post-study engineering equivalence
demonstration, not another independent statistical confirmation or a new
fault-selection study.
